title: Cherry Tomato Butter Pasta with Ricotta
subtitle: roasted tomato and garlic sauce
description: A sauce of oven-roasted cherry tomatoes and garlic, blended smooth and enriched with ricotta, butter and parmesan. Pure comfort on a plate.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and cook the pasta according to the packet directions.
Put the cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil and salt in a heatproof dish. Roast for about 20 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft and charred.
Transfer the tomato mixture to a blender and blend until as smooth as possible.
Strain the sauce through a fine sieve straight into a frying pan (an important step for the texture, so don't skip it). Add the butter, pasta cooking water, ricotta and some parmesan.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan and toss well so the sauce coats it.
Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with more parmesan.
